about: Google Maps 360° views to show inside the campus map with Google's own embed (no key). Every building's sheet already asks Google for the 360° view nearest its door when it is shown; list a view here only to pick a particular one: node scripts/add-streetview.mjs '<Google Maps address or Share → Embed code of the view>'.
noGoogleViewNote: Buildings Google Maps had no 360° view near (October 2026). Their sheets show the view at the nearest building that has one, marked 在这附近. Take the code out when someone adds a view there.
